title: Planted-defect list
description: Derived from design/EVALUATION_INTERFACES.md 1.0 (Draft); the document wins. Proposal: Tillman Heisner accepts, changes or replaces it (Evaluation interfaces, section 4). The defects planted in one record variant or in its round-1 issues (section 4.1 rule 7): one row per defect, with the pointer, what was planted, the parent record's SHA-256, the expected catcher, the expected kind and the expected verdict.
$comment: Derived from design/EVALUATION_INTERFACES.md 1.0 (Draft); the document wins. Section 4.1 rule 4 leaves the file format (CSV, JSON or another) to the builder; this file describes the JSON form, with one object per row in rows. Key names that section 4 does not give are marked 'Proposed name' in their description. Kept on the expected side only (3.2). A defect that is expected to raise two issues, as family DV1 proposes for some placeholders, needs one row per expected kind under this proposal. expected_verdict is left out where no verdict applies, for example an issue the verification agent itself should raise.

item_id.description: The item the file is for (4.1 rule 1).

variant_id.description: The variant the file is for (4.1 rule 1).

input_files.description: Proposed name. The input-side files the expected file was built for, each with its SHA-256 (4.1 rule 1). If a checksum no longer matches, the scorer skips the item and reports it.

evaluation_interfaces_version.description: Proposed name. The version of design/EVALUATION_INTERFACES.md the file follows (4.1 rule 1).

expected_file_version.description: Proposed name. The version of this expected file; a reviewed finding goes into a new version, and scores name it (4.1 rule 5).

canary.description: Only if canaries are adopted (5.3): the file's canary, random and at least 32 characters long. Option CS7, a canary in every row, would add a row field.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer into the EnzymeML document, for example /measurements/0/ph (Issue format 2). For software only; scientists never see pointers.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 checksum: 64 hexadecimal characters, computed by software (Evaluation interfaces 3.1).

input_file.description: One input-side file the expected file was built for, with its checksum (4.1 rule 1). Field names from Evaluation interfaces 3.1.

pointer.description: Proposed name. Where the defect was planted.

planted.description: Proposed name. What was planted, for example Km 0.82 with the quote '0.082'.

parent_sha256.description: The parent record's SHA-256 (name as in Evaluation interfaces 3.2).

expected_catcher.description: Proposed name. Who should catch the defect.

expected_kind.description: Proposed name. The expected issue kind (Issue format 4.1).

expected_verdict.description: Proposed name. The expected verdict; never uncertain.

family.description: Proposed name. The family of section 5, for example V2.

pending.description: Proposed name. true for a row not yet settled: left out of scores and listed (4.1 rule 3). Frozen test-set files hold no pending rows.
